mcq_drop.why: vague essay-style statements on 'debates'; not exam-shaped

pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: President's Rule / S.R. Bommai (emergency provisions)

patterns: Direct case-to-ruling questions: which case held FRs prevail over DPSPs (Champakam), first propounded basic structure (Kesavananda), first limited amending power (Golaknath).
Chronological ordering of Gopalan, Golaknath, Kesavananda, Minerva Mills is a recurring shape.
APPSC asks 'choose the WRONG statement' on DPSP character (non-justiciable, fundamental in governance) and which case is not about right to property.
Bench-size / First Amendment purpose (agrarian reforms, Ninth Schedule under Nehru) trivia recur.
App MCQs go deeper (31C provisions, Property Owners Association 2024, 17th Amendment) with multi-statement shapes; PYQs are mostly single-fact.
